function holderExtensionCommitment(KCC20MintExtensionV1 extension): byte[32] {

functions.span:
entry mint_by_owner(
        KCC20MintExtensionV1 extension,
        sig authority_signature,
        byte[32] to_owner,
        byte to_owner_scheme,
        byte to_borrow_scheme,
        byte[32] to_borrow_guard,
        int token_amount,
        int token_output_index,
        int minter_output_index,
        int treasury_output_index,
        int fee_output_index
    ) {
        requireMinter(extension);
        require(checkSig(authority_signature, pubkey(extension.creator)));
        mintTokens(
            extension,
            to_owner,
            to_owner_scheme,
            to_borrow_scheme,
            to_borrow_guard,
            token_amount,
            token_output_index,
            minter_output_index,
            treasury_output_index,
            fee_output_index
        );
    }
